description: 群益證券 SKCOM 海外報價(國際外匯 + 海外期貨)的 .NET 10 用戶端,只接報價,不含下單與帳務。SKCOM 是 COM 元件,由隨套件出貨的 x64 宿主行程(Ozakboy.TradeKit.Capital.Host,建置時複製到輸出目錄的 capital-host\)掛載,用戶端以 stdio 換行分隔 JSON 與它溝通:帳密只走子行程環境變數、宿主讀完即清;登入失敗絕不重試,宿主崩潰以退避重啟並重送訂閱,報價主機斷線(3002)由宿主退避重連。價格一律 decimal(原始整數 ÷ 10^小數位數;K 線的單精度浮點文字依小數位數四捨五入),成交與分 K 時間依交易所時區轉 UTC(分 K 的時間是那一分鐘的結束)。0.2.0 起另可查國內期貨歷史 K 線(台指 / 小台 / 微台近月,分 K 與日 K,全盤或 AM 盤;需群益期貨戶),國內狀態與海外分開,國內不可用不影響海外;宿主放進 Job Object、stdin 結束或父行程消失即結束,不留孤兒行程。需使用者自行從群益官網下載 SKCOM 並以系統管理員註冊 x64 版。預期失敗一律回 Result,錯誤碼 capital.* 集中在 CapitalErrorCodes。A .NET 10 client for the overseas quotes (international FX and overseas futures) of Capital Securities' SKCOM API: quotes only, no orders or accounts. SKCOM is a COM component, so an x64 host process shipped in this package (copied to capital-host\ in the build output) loads it, and the client talks to it over newline-delimited JSON on stdio. Credentials travel only through the child process's environment and the host clears them after reading; a failed login is never retried, a crashed host is restarted with backoff and its subscriptions re-sent, and a quote-server disconnect (3002) is reconnected by the host with backoff. Prices are always decimal, and tick and minute-bar times are converted to UTC by the exchange's time zone (a minute bar's time is the end of its minute). Since 0.2.0 it also fetches domestic futures historical K-lines (TAIEX, mini and micro TAIEX futures, near month; minute and daily bars, full or AM session; a Capital futures account is required) with a domestic state kept apart from the overseas one, and the host is placed in a Job Object and ends on stdin EOF or when its parent disappears, so no orphaned process is left behind. The user downloads SKCOM from Capital's site and registers the x64 build as an administrator. Every expected failure is a Result with a capital.* code from CapitalErrorCodes.
releaseNotes: 0.2.0 — Domestic futures historical K-lines: CapitalHostSession.GetDomesticKLinesAsync (SKQuoteLib RequestKLineAMByDate; TX00, MTX00, TM0000; minute and daily bars; full or AM session; trading-day dates; minute open time = Taipei end time minus one minute in UTC; empty bars kept; the 60,000-row cap keeps the newest), a domestic state with DomesticStateChanged kept apart from the overseas state (an unavailable domestic side never affects overseas quotes), and the kline-tw host method with capital.kline.timeout and capital.domestic.unavailable. Fixed: an orphaned host kept running after its parent ended; the client now puts the host in a KILL_ON_JOB_CLOSE Job Object and the host also ends when its parent PID disappears, with a forced exit if an orderly shutdown hangs. Docs: the host ships self-contained, so no .NET Desktop Runtime install is needed. Known: full-session closes are settlement prices; Capital's 2026-10-30 night-session volume is doubled; overseas minute bars go back about one month and one request has a row limit (oldest rows dropped silently), so record coverage from the first bar received. 0.1.0 — First release. CapitalHostSession starts and supervises the shipped SKCOM host (credentials only through child-process environment variables, never a file or a log), reads quote and tick events into a bounded channel that drops the oldest and counts, lists overseas products, subscribes, and fetches K-lines (minute, day, week, month). A failed login is never retried; an unexpected host exit is restarted with 1, 2, 5, 10 and 30 second backoff up to MaxRestarts and the subscriptions are re-sent. Measured against SKCOM 2.13.59 on 2026-11-06: product list and details, quotes, ticks with replay, K-lines, and the FX, CME, CBOT and NYM time zones. Not measured: the 3002 reconnect, login failure codes other than by the manual, and the time zones of other exchanges (IsVerified = false). Full notes: https://github.com/ozakboy/Ozakboy.TradeKit.Capital/blob/main/CHANGELOG.md
title: Ozakboy.TradeKit.Capital — 群益 SKCOM 海外報價(外匯 + 海期)與國內期貨歷史 K 線用戶端
